verdict.rationale: The GitHub README says agents can run locally, in Docker, on VMs, or anywhere an agent server backend can run. The docs add a self-hostable agent server exposing an HTTP/WebSocket API, an Apptainer sandbox option for rootless HPC environments, a free local open-source tier, and licensed Enterprise self-hosting. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of self-hosted deployments, and detailed VM deployment documentation beyond the README claim.
